cloud_lane_enabled.description: Allows the opt-in format researcher to call cloud Gemini with public documentation. The app's built-in default is false (fail closed).

batch_size.description: How many files are converted in parallel.

cloud_model.description: Cloud model used by the format researcher (public documentation only).

cloud_max_output_tokens.description: Output token cap for cloud calls.

cloud_thinking_level.description: Gemini thinking level for the format researcher: MINIMAL, LOW, MEDIUM or HIGH; empty leaves it to the model.

nano_chunk_chars.description: Maximum characters of recovered text per on-device call (Nano's context is 9216 tokens).

ai_max_attempts.description: Structured-output validation attempts before falling back to deterministic output.
